subStages.name: Brochure / fee structure requested
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the latest brochure and fee structure by WhatsApp/email, briefly explain the program, and schedule a follow-up within 24 hours.

subStages.name: Self level evaluation stage
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the eligibility and program-fit checklist, help the candidate evaluate their profile, and fix a date to discuss the outcome.

subStages.name: Family discussion stage
subStages.counsellorAction: Share parent-relevant information on the program, PPO, fees and campus, then record a specific date to follow up after the discussion.

subStages.name: Campus visit plan
subStages.counsellorAction: Confirm the visit date and time, send the campus location and contact person, and share a reminder one day before the visit.

subStages.name: Call Back
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the exact callback date and time in the CRM and contact the candidate at the agreed time.

subStages.name: Parents Counselling Stage
subStages.counsellorAction: Arrange a call or meeting with the parent, explain the career pathway, selection process, fees and support facilities, and address their questions.

subStages.name: Busy right now
subStages.counsellorAction: Ask for a convenient callback slot, record it in the CRM, and avoid repeated calls before the agreed time.

subStages.name: Hot
subStages.counsellorAction: Contact the lead the same day, answer pending questions, and move the candidate to the immediate next step with a confirmed date.

subStages.name: Warm
subStages.counsellorAction: Address the main concern, share relevant information, and schedule the next follow-up within two to three working days.

subStages.name: Cold
subStages.counsellorAction: Add the lead to a low-frequency nurture plan, share only relevant updates, and schedule a follow-up after seven to fourteen days.

subStages.name: Not interested in the program
subStages.counsellorAction: Ask for the main reason, record it accurately, offer a suitable alternative only if relevant, and close the lead if interest remains low.

subStages.name: Not interested in finance/accounting career
subStages.counsellorAction: Understand the candidate's preferred career direction, provide guidance only if relevant, and close the lead when there is no program fit.

subStages.name: Just exploring / information only
subStages.counsellorAction: Share a concise program overview, offer a career counselling call, and schedule a low-pressure follow-up based on the candidate's timeline.

subStages.name: No current plan to pursue a course
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the likely decision timeline, obtain consent for future updates, and move the lead to the appropriate future follow-up cycle.

subStages.name: Prefers another course or certification
subStages.counsellorAction: Understand the candidate's career goal, explain the relevant differences factually, and close or redirect the lead based on the final preference.

subStages.name: Prefers regular degree / MBA
subStages.counsellorAction: Clarify how the candidate's preferred degree differs from the GCC School pathway, answer questions, and close the lead if the preference remains unchanged.

subStages.name: Not ready for full-time training
subStages.counsellorAction: Identify the time or commitment constraint, discuss a future cohort if suitable, and record the correct follow-up month.

subStages.name: Looking only for a job
subStages.counsellorAction: Explain the interview-first, hire-first model and eligibility requirements; move eligible candidates forward or close the lead if they do not want training.

subStages.name: Asked not to contact again
subStages.counsellorAction: Mark the lead as Do Not Contact immediately and stop all calls, messages, emails and automated follow-ups.

subStages.name: Reason not disclosed
subStages.counsellorAction: Make one polite attempt to understand the reason; if the candidate declines, record 'reason not disclosed' and close the lead.

subStages.name: Wrong number
subStages.counsellorAction: Verify the number once from the original source; if it remains incorrect, mark the lead invalid and stop communication.

subStages.name: Duplicate lead
subStages.counsellorAction: Link or merge the record with the original lead, retain the correct owner and interaction history, and close the duplicate record.

subStages.name: Consultant / agency / vendor call
subStages.counsellorAction: Remove the record from the admissions funnel and route it to the relevant partnership, procurement or administration contact if required.

subStages.name: Enquired by mistake
subStages.counsellorAction: Confirm that no enquiry was intended, mark the lead invalid, and stop further admission communication.

subStages.name: Test lead
subStages.counsellorAction: Tag the record as a test lead and exclude it from counsellor follow-ups, campaign automation and conversion reports.

subStages.name: Still in Graduation
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the course, year and expected graduation date, move the lead to Future Batch, and schedule follow-up near eligibility.

subStages.name: Still in School
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the expected Class 12 completion year and retain the lead only for consent-based long-term career awareness communication.

subStages.name: Out of TG
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the exact eligibility criterion not met, check for a suitable alternative only if available, and close the lead.

subStages.name: Other Degree
subStages.counsellorAction: Verify the candidate's complete academic profile against eligibility rules, refer a suitable option if available, and close if ineligible.

subStages.name: Ringing / No answer
subStages.counsellorAction: Attempt contact at different time slots, send a brief WhatsApp message explaining the purpose, and log every attempt in the CRM.

subStages.name: Switched off
subStages.counsellorAction: Retry later the same day and the next working day, send a WhatsApp message if available, and record the next attempt date.

subStages.name: Out of coverage area
subStages.counsellorAction: Retry after a few hours and on the next working day, send a WhatsApp message, and log the contact attempts.

subStages.name: Call disconnected
subStages.counsellorAction: Send a short WhatsApp message stating the purpose of the call and ask for a convenient callback time before trying again.

subStages.name: Number Not Reachable
subStages.counsellorAction: Check the number format and source, try an available alternate channel, and mark invalid if no valid contact method exists.

subStages.name: Language barrier
subStages.counsellorAction: Candidate could not continue in your language. Admin is alerted to reassign to a counsellor who speaks it.

subStages.name: NFET details shared
subStages.counsellorAction: Confirm that the candidate understands the NFET process, share the registration link and deadline, and schedule the next follow-up.

subStages.name: NFET profile pending
subStages.counsellorAction: Guide the candidate to complete the profile, clarify missing information, and set a completion deadline.

subStages.name: NFET Documents Pending
subStages.counsellorAction: Send the exact list of missing documents, assist with submission, and verify each document when received.

subStages.name: NFET Profile Completed
subStages.counsellorAction: Verify the completed profile and documents, update the CRM, and guide the candidate to the registration payment step.

subStages.name: NFET registration - payment pending
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the authorised payment link and due date, explain the payment process, and follow up before the deadline.

subStages.name: NFET registration - payment done
subStages.counsellorAction: Verify the transaction, update the payment status, send acknowledgement, and share the next NFET step.

subStages.name: NFET scheduled
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the exam date, time and instructions, confirm attendance, and send reminders 24 hours and two hours before the exam.

subStages.name: NFET appeared - result awaited
subStages.counsellorAction: Confirm attendance, thank the candidate, communicate the expected result timeline, and update the lead as soon as the result is available.

subStages.name: NFET No Show
subStages.counsellorAction: Contact the candidate the same day, record the reason, and reschedule only if permitted under the current policy.

subStages.name: NFET Passed
subStages.counsellorAction: Congratulate the candidate, explain the interview process, collect any pending details, and book the interview slot.

subStages.name: NFET Failed
subStages.counsellorAction: Communicate the result sensitively, explain an approved retest or alternative pathway if available, and record the candidate's decision.

subStages.name: NFET Retest
subStages.counsellorAction: Confirm retest eligibility, share the revised schedule and preparation guidance, and send reminders before the retest.

subStages.name: Interview Slot Booked
subStages.counsellorAction: Send the interview confirmation, required documents and preparation instructions, and share reminders one day and two hours before the slot.

subStages.name: Interview No Show
subStages.counsellorAction: Contact the candidate the same day, record the reason, and offer one reschedule if allowed and the candidate remains interested.

subStages.name: Interview Appeared
subStages.counsellorAction: Mark attendance, collect interviewer feedback, communicate the expected result timeline, and keep the candidate updated.

subStages.name: Interview Cleared
subStages.counsellorAction: Congratulate the candidate, explain the PPO and admission steps, collect pending documents, and set the next action date.

subStages.name: Interview Rejected
subStages.counsellorAction: Communicate the result professionally, record the reason or feedback, and discuss a future or alternative pathway only if applicable.

subStages.name: Interview Stop Responding
subStages.counsellorAction: Make structured attempts through call, WhatsApp and email over seven days; log each attempt and move to Closed - Lost if there is no response.

subStages.name: Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) letter issued
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the PPO through the approved channel, explain the terms and acceptance deadline, and schedule a follow-up before expiry.

subStages.name: PPO letter accepted / signed
subStages.counsellorAction: Verify and upload the signed PPO, update the CRM, and move the candidate to registration and fee processing.

subStages.name: Registration payment pending
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the authorised payment link, amount and due date, resolve payment questions, and follow up before the deadline.

subStages.name: Registration payment done
subStages.counsellorAction: Verify the payment, issue acknowledgement or receipt, update the CRM, and communicate the next fee or documentation step.

subStages.name: Direct Payment - pending
subStages.counsellorAction: Confirm the payable amount, due date and authorised payment method, then share the link and schedule a payment follow-up.

subStages.name: Direct Payment - in parts
subStages.counsellorAction: Document the approved instalment plan and due dates, send reminders before each instalment, and issue receipts after payment.

subStages.name: Opt in for Loan
subStages.counsellorAction: Obtain consent to connect the candidate with the finance partner, share the document checklist, and assign a follow-up owner.

subStages.name: Loan Documentation Stage
subStages.counsellorAction: Track the required documents, help resolve missing or incorrect items, and update the application status in the CRM.

subStages.name: Loan in process
subStages.counsellorAction: Follow up with the finance partner and candidate, communicate status updates, and record the expected decision or disbursement date.

subStages.name: Program fee - fully paid
subStages.counsellorAction: Reconcile the full payment, issue the final receipt, update the fee status, and complete the admission and onboarding handover.

subStages.name: Refund
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the refund reason and request in writing, verify eligibility under policy, escalate for approval, and track the case until closure.

subStages.name: Seat Cancel
subStages.counsellorAction: Obtain written cancellation confirmation, record the reason, stop the admission process, and initiate the applicable refund workflow.

subStages.name: 12th appearing (Commerce) - nurture for future batch
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the expected Class 12 completion date, obtain consent for updates, and schedule follow-up after exams or results.

subStages.name: B.Com / BBA Persuing
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the year, semester and expected graduation date, share relevant career content, and schedule periodic future-batch follow-ups.

subStages.name: Final year appearing - target next batch
subStages.counsellorAction: Record exam and result timelines, schedule follow-up near completion, and share eligibility and interview-preparation information.

subStages.name: Interested but wants next batch - follow up at next intake
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the preferred cohort and an exact follow-up date, then share only relevant updates until the next intake opens.

subStages.name: Not willing to join
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the primary reason, confirm closure respectfully, and stop repeated follow-ups unless the candidate consents to future updates.

subStages.name: Fee concern
subStages.counsellorAction: Understand the affordability gap, explain fees, ROI and available financing accurately, offer one follow-up, and close if the concern remains unresolved.

subStages.name: Location issue
subStages.counsellorAction: Explain the Gurugram campus, connectivity, safe PG, homemade food and pick-and-drop options, then confirm whether relocation is still a barrier.

subStages.name: Parents not convinced
subStages.counsellorAction: Offer a parent counselling call, address concerns with clear program and career information, and make one agreed follow-up.

subStages.name: Looking only for CA / CS / CMA career
subStages.counsellorAction: Clarify that GCC School is not conventional exam coaching, refer to a relevant KC GlobEd option if suitable, and close the GCC School lead.

subStages.name: Looking only for degree / MBA admission
subStages.counsellorAction: Clarify the scope of GCC School, direct the candidate to an appropriate institution or option if known, and close the lead.

subStages.name: Already employed in a GCC
subStages.counsellorAction: Understand the candidate's upskilling or career-growth need, suggest a relevant option only if suitable, and close if no need exists.

subStages.name: Joined another institute / program
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the selected program if the candidate is comfortable sharing it, congratulate them, and close the lead respectfully.

subStages.name: Dropping this year
subStages.counsellorAction: Record the expected restart timeline, move to Future Batch with consent, or close the lead if no follow-up is requested.

subStages.name: Stopped answering after counselling (5-7 attempts)
subStages.counsellorAction: Send one final closure message by WhatsApp or email, mark the lead Closed - Lost, and stop current-cycle follow-ups.

subStages.name: Admission confirmed - seat allotted
subStages.counsellorAction: Update the admission ID, cohort, payment and document status; send seat confirmation and notify the academic and operations teams.

subStages.name: Welcome message sent
subStages.counsellorAction: Share the onboarding pack, orientation schedule, reporting instructions and required access details, then hand over the student to the onboarding team.
